highland-park.notes: Residential garbage is once weekly by area; businesses receive twice-weekly collection. Metal bulk items go out on regular garbage day. Electronics and other specialty items are DPW drop-off only. Automated garbage routes use borough-issued carts; second cart specifications on DPW page. No private residential hauler stated.

dropoff.hours: Sat Dec 26, 2026 and Sat Jan 2, 2027, 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. (cardboard only)

metuchen.notes: Jersey Avenue drop-off recycling center is closed; curbside single-stream only for eligible properties. Businesses/condos/apartments using a private garbage hauler must contract private recycling; DPW continues recycling where it provides garbage service. DPW does not collect TVs/electronics curbside. Zone boundaries: Main Street and Pennsylvania Railroad (metuchennj.org/resident/trash). Borough Hall (500 Main Street) is separate from DPW operations phone 732-632-8540.
